text: The silver star was missing. Lila said, “I need a star.” Nia told Lila, “I can help you.” Lila fetched the needle from the costume shelf. The brass button was heavy. Lila used the needle to stitch the brass button on the felt star. Lila shortened the felt star's loop. Lila said, “I have a light.” Lila put the felt star beside the Moon puppet. Lila returned the needle to the costume shelf. The brass button shone beside the red curtain.
